{{Recipe summary
| Category = Chicken recipes
| Servings = 4
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:chicken|chicken]] breasts
* ~3 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 1 can (28 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]/800 [[Cookbook:ML|ml]]) whole [[Cookbook:tomato|tomatoes]]
* 3 cloves of [[Cookbook:garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:cinnamon|cinnamon]] sticks
* ¼–½ [[Cookbook:peach|peach]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] finely OR 1–2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 1 splash of [[Cookbook:vinegar|vinegar]]
* [[Cookbook:salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:pepper|Pepper]] to taste
* Enough [[Cookbook:pasta|pasta]] for 4 servings (cheese tortellini is good)

== Procedure == 
# Heat olive oil in a medium [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
# Lightly brown the chicken breasts in the oil—don't cook them through.
# Add the onion and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] for a couple of minutes.
# Add peach (if you're using peach) and fry for another minute.
# Cut the tomatoes in half and add them.
# Add everything else and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]], covered, for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
# Remove the lid and let it simmer for about 15 more minutes.
# In the meantime, cook the pasta according to the directions on the package.
# Remove cinnamon sticks from sauce. Serve over hot pasta with freshly-grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan]] and garlic bread.
